title: All-in-One Marketing Platform / Transit pair
slide_intent: Let neighboring panels divide the work because an attention-getting image and a product explanation may need different spaces.
strategic_value: The surreal portrait beside a direct growth message can broaden Mailchimp’s offer while retaining an unconventional personality.
demonstration: Two adjacent transit posters pair a colorful photographic scene at left with large black copy and the signature on green at right.
practical_value: Compare image-led attention with text-led explanation across a paired placement.

content_islands.name: Image panel
content_islands.spec: Keep the unusual portrait and colored set together on the left poster.

content_islands.name: Message panel
content_islands.spec: Use the right green poster for the multiline marketing-platform message and lower-right signature.

content_islands.name: Placement
content_islands.spec: Retain the wall and handrail to show the real viewing context.

reference_purposes.Application: The identity appears as adjacent transit advertising panels.
reference_purposes.Expression: Surreal photography is paired with a plain-language platform message and a green field.
